summary: A CC0 Drosophila species-pair isolation dataset and single-pair studies are public, but no multi-taxon table of attempted interspecific crosses with fertility outcomes (and failed crosses) was found, so the claim's 'plants and animals' scope is not covered.
next_step: Locate the Coyne & Orr and Lowry/Moyle supplementary tables (paper supplements, not repository deposits) and combine with the Drosophila deposit and TimeTree divergence times before pre-registering the proportion test.
obstacles_confirmed: Failed and null crosses are under-reported; no denominator of attempted crosses found.
Public coverage found is dominated by Drosophila, which cannot represent plants and animals at large.
